source_refs.note: Exercise 11.1, Question 5: book page 290 (Q1-Q8). The book prints no answers for Unit 11; every answer here is ours.

blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein components pehle se diye hue hain; humein sirf unhein jor kar vector banana hai aur domain batana hai.
Kitab mein \(x(t)\) ke andar \(r\) chhapa hai, jo asal mein \(t\) hona chahiye (neeche correction dekhein): \(x(t) = t^2 + 1\).
Rule: vector function ka domain un sab \(t\) ka set hai jahan har component defined ho.
Plan: pehle vector form, phir har component ka domain, aur aakhir mein un ka intersection (mushtarka hissa).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x(t) = t^2 + 1\) (kitab mein \(r^2 + 1\) chhapa hai), \(y(t) = \sqrt{t}\).
Maloom karna: \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) aur us ka domain.
Tareeqa: 11.1.3 ka Step-2 aur Step-3 (Step-1 yani components to diye hue hain). Domain woh set hai jahan har component defined ho (11.2).

Vector form mein jorein
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = x(t)\,\hat{i} + y(t)\,\hat{j}\]
\[= (t^2 + 1)\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{t}\,\hat{j}\]
\[= \langle t^2 + 1, \sqrt{t}\rangle\]
Kyun: do components hain, is liye yeh 2D vector function hai. \(x\) ko \(\hat{i}\) ke saath aur \(y\) ko \(\hat{j}\) ke saath likha. Angle brackets \(\langle\ ,\ \rangle\) wali shakal aur \(\hat{i}, \hat{j}\) wali shakal ek hi baat hai, bas likhne ka andaz alag hai.

Har component ka domain
\(t^2 + 1\): har real \(t\) par defined, domain \(\mathbb{R}\).
\(\sqrt{t}\): \(t \ge 0\) chahiye, domain \([0, \infty)\).
Kyun: polynomial par koi pabandi nahin hoti, koi bhi number rakh lein. Lekin negative number ka square root real nahin hota, is liye \(\sqrt{t}\) ke liye \(t\) zero ya positive hona chahiye.

Intersection lein
\[\mathbb{R} \cap [0, \infty) = [0, \infty)\]
Kyun: \(t\) tabhi qabool hai jab dono components mojood hon (11.2.1 ka Step-2). Jaise do darwazon wala kamra: andar jane ke liye dono darwaze khule hone chahiye.
Dhyan dein: union nahin, intersection lena hai.

Tasdeeq values se
\[\mathbf{r}(0) = \hat{i},\quad \mathbf{r}(1) = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j}\]
\[\mathbf{r}(4) = 17\hat{i} + 2\hat{j}\]
\(\mathbf{r}(-1)\) mojood nahin, kyunke \(\sqrt{-1}\) real nahin \(\checkmark\).
Kyun: \(t\) khatam karein (\(t = y^2\), \(y \ge 0\)) to raasta \(x = y^4 + 1\) banta hai jo point \((1, 0)\) se shuru hota hai. Yani curve ka ek sira hai, yeh dono taraf nahin phailta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein \(x(t) = r^2 + 1\) chhapa hai. \(x\) to \(t\) ka function hai, aur \(r\) us vector function ka naam hai jo humein banana hai; is liye \(x(t)\) ke andar \(r^2\) ka koi matlab nahin. Sahi component \(x(t) = t^2 + 1\) hai, aur oopar hum ne isi ko istemal kiya hai.
